highlights_headline: Backports the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs, plus a WinUI packaging fix.

bullets.detail: Brings the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app target framework monikers to the 3.119.x servicing line.
Fixes a missing WinUI projection DLL that .NET 9 consumers hit at runtime.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library support and unversioned app TFMs to the 3.119.x line.
